dataset_versions.injection_corpus: self-generated, scripts/make_injection_corpus.py (see its manifest for its own git_commit)

measurement_formulation: normalised chromaticity r,g,b = C/(R+G+B) per frame
note: Live check on a real sensor + display, three passes on the same hardware in the same room: WB/AE locked with the challenge rendered (primary), auto WB/AE with it rendered (shows what locking buys), and locked with nothing rendered (control, and a genuine no-cast negative for calibration). Records aggregate per-frame region colour means only -- no frames retained, no face required or stored. correlation_exact_alignment uses the step actually on screen per frame; correlation_b6_even_split reproduces what pqbio.binding.verify's B6 actually computes, so the difference is the cost of that documented approximation.

regional_chromatic_response.interpretation: A region actually lit by the screen shows its B:R ratio rise on blue steps. Spread <0.02 across all regions means no cast reached the sensor at all; a large spread in some region means the cast is physically present and the limitation is where/how B6 measures, not the mechanism.
